PAIRS = {'(': ')', '[': ']', '{': '}', '<': '>'}
CLOSE = {v: k for k, v in PAIRS.items()}

INPUT = "< ( ( [ < > { [ { ( ) } ] < { < { } > [ ( < > ) ] } > } [ < > ] ] ) { { ( { ( ( [ ( [ ] ) ] < { } > ) ) { { ( [ [ ] ] ) } [ ( ) ] { { [ ] } } } } ) } ( { } ) }"
SUBMITTED = "< ( ( [ < > { [ { ( ) } ] < { < { } > [ ( < > ) ] } > } [ < > ] ] ) { { ( { ( ( [ ( [ ] ) ] < { } > ) ) { { ( [ [ ] ] ) } [ ( ) ] { { [ ] } } } } ) } ( { } ) } } } >"


def tokens(s):
    return [c for c in s if not c.isspace()]


def scan(seq):
    """Return (ok, residual_stack). ok is False on a mismatch or unknown symbol."""
    stack = []
    for c in seq:
        if c in PAIRS:
            stack.append(c)
        elif c in CLOSE:
            if not stack or stack[-1] != CLOSE[c]:
                return False, stack
            stack.pop()
        else:
            return False, None
    return True, stack


inp = tokens(INPUT)
n = len(inp)

in_ok, residual = scan(inp)
if not in_ok:

else:

    expected = [PAIRS[c] for c in reversed(residual)]

    sub = tokens(SUBMITTED)

    sub_balanced = sub_ok and sub_residual == []
    prefix_ok = sub[:n] == inp
    suffix = sub[n:]

    print("input_length:", n)
    print("input_residual_open_stack:", "".join(residual))
    print("expected_completion:", " ".join(expected))
    print("submitted_suffix:", " ".join(suffix))
    print("submitted_prefix_matches_input:", prefix_ok)
    print("submitted_fully_balanced:", sub_balanced)

    if sub_balanced and prefix_ok and suffix == expected:

    else:
